zoe: Heads-up: running a short pricing-page experiment next week. Plan: add an inline estimator widget, refresh tier names, and tighten FAQ copy. Goal = fewer Contact Sales clicks and more self-serve signups. Need owners for copy, embed, analytics, and routing. leo: I'll take the embed + QA. Can we decide iframe vs JS widget? JS widget preferred for faster SSR fallback. tanya: I'll own FAQ and tier copy. Proposed tiers: Starter / Growth / Enterprise. Also suggest CTA variant: 'Estimate your monthly cost' for experiment. ev an: Analytics & routing: events = rw_estimator_open, rw_estimator_submit, rw_estimator_value_usd, rw_contact_cta. Payload includes estimated_monthly_usd, tier_choice, utm_campaign, anonymous_id. Routing rule: if estimated_monthly_usd >= 5000 OR tier_choice == 'Enterprise' => AE webhook; else MQL. salesbot: Confirmed webhook fields; will ingest estimated_segment. Also request a boolean field 'interested_dedicated' for faster triage. legal-bot: Reminder: avoid guaranteed SLA language. Use "Enterprise plans offer optional SLA-backed support" in copy. zoe: Timeline: widget into staging by Tue, QA Wed, experiment live Thu. Run for 21 days. Metrics: primary = pricing page CTA -> signup conversion. Secondary = Contact Sales click rate. leo: Prototype snippet (JS widget): ```html
``` I'll add GA4 mappings and push PR to staging. tanya: I'll drop FAQ diffs to the shared doc by EOD Monday and update the CTA copy. ezan: (typo) Evan: I'll add BigQuery mapping and alert if contact_cta spikes. zoe: Great. Marketing will draft a short benchmark narrative for the launch post and a follow-up webinar to highlight cost savings. I'll loop product & sales for the webinar. Ping me with issues. :rocket:
